completeness: Curated texture sources for CS2 map authoring. Each Poly Haven listing provides base color, normal and roughness maps.

items.name: Concrete
items.description: Weathered concrete panels with vertical grooves and streaked surfaces for outdoor walls.

items.requirementLabel: PBR textures · Build a Source 2 material
items.compatibility: Download the PNG maps from Poly Haven. Assign the base color, normal and roughness maps in the CS2 Workshop Tools Material Editor, then save the material in your map’s addon.
items.format: PNG PBR maps (base color, normal, roughness)
